scope: Page-referenced source audit, not a remeasurement.

evidence.supported_statement: Outer front is present; source image-pattern speed about 500 +/- 20 km/s.
evidence.inference_limit: Not a plasma velocity, normal speed, or independent MHD label.

evidence.supported_statement: The weak front traverses the CDS field of view.
evidence.locator: M2015 p.3 reporting HS2003; inherited audits 19/19A
evidence.inference_limit: FOV crossing does not supply a new pixel-time registration or resolved state pair.

evidence.supported_statement: The front passes under the SUMER slit during 15:31-15:39 UT.
evidence.inference_limit: Positive geometric sampling at source level; not a newly measured trajectory.

evidence.supported_statement: No substantial line shift; the source reports an approximate LOS response below 10 km/s.
evidence.locator: M2015 p.3 reporting HS2003; retained audits
evidence.inference_limit: Instrument-conditioned response scale; no independent normal-flow bound or confidence level.

evidence.supported_statement: No wave signature in the first exposure; useful first-window lines have log10(Tmax/K) about 4.9-5.8.
evidence.inference_limit: Response temperature is not a measured front temperature; lack of detection does not prove T > 600000 K or T > 1 MK.

evidence.supported_statement: Later strong Doppler emission belongs to an asymmetric eruptive filament.
evidence.inference_limit: The same eruption does not make this the same front or the same plasma patch.

evidence.supported_statement: Reported body speeds reach about 150 km/s; the leading material reaches about 300-350 km/s.
evidence.locator: M2015 pp.8-9; source reports and reanalysis distinguished in review
evidence.inference_limit: Do not combine these filament components with the outer-front image speed.

evidence.supported_statement: The event-related 609 A blue wing can be accounted for by O IV 609.83 A, blended with Mg X 609.79 A.
evidence.inference_limit: Not proof of a hot coronal component; not proof that all coronal/background emission is absent.

evidence.supported_statement: The apparent Doppler rise occurs as faster leading material enters the slit.
evidence.inference_limit: Space-time sampling change is not acceleration of a tracked plasma element.

evidence.supported_statement: Compression and outer wave separate after about 15:33 UT; dimming/compression disperses before reaching SUMER.
evidence.inference_limit: Do not use the semicircle fits or Table 2 dimming speeds as local outer-front measurements.

evidence.supported_statement: The relative rest component is obtained from an upper-left raster region unaffected by the filament.
evidence.inference_limit: A spectral reference is not independently identified as local upstream plasma.

evidence.supported_statement: Published Doppler errors include at least 5 km/s fitting uncertainty and at least 5 km/s relative-reference uncertainty.
evidence.inference_limit: Neither a joint confidence interval nor independent Gaussian errors is specified; do not add in quadrature without justification.
